title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator meeting agent for GCC
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing and documented controls are supported, and the briefing distinguishes general Facilitator documentation from the unconfirmed GCC behaviour. Two minor corrections remain: clarify the command reference's ambiguous blocking example, and remove the checklist instruction for a control missing from the table.

claims.fix: Append to controls[0].note: 'The Update-M365TeamsApp reference describes its -IsBlocked $true example as unblocking an app; verify the intended state before scripting this control.' Keep the call: its names and value are documented, but do not describe $true as a confirmed blocking operation.

claims.where: controls[1].api; rendered controls table
